justification: New production table (migration 058) + ETL ingest writing 397 rows, feeding user-facing serviceability wording with liability implications (DSP price, capacity status). Above Minor because it creates a data pipeline and a new table; below Critical because it is a backend ingest not yet wired to any user surface and touches no existing rows (additive, reversible by DROP TABLE).

pre_impl.existing_data: New standalone table sydney_water_gsp_servicing; reads no existing tables. spatial_overlays was inspected and rejected (no attributes column, bigint source_oid, instrument/LGA scope GSP polygons don't fit). Source = 3 public Sydney Water GeoJSON files (205 WW + 192 DW).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the source schema drifts (field renamed/removed), transform() raises on missing SWC_Unique_Identifier and the dry-run integrity assertions (row count 397, valid status set, MULTIPOLYGON geometry, unique keys) fail loudly before any write. DSP price format change -> parse returns None (never a wrong number). Verified live: 0/397 invalid geometries.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Insert-then-upsert on conflict (product, swc_id); an annual refresh updates in place. No existing rows in any other table are read or modified. Reversal is DROP TABLE sydney_water_gsp_servicing.

functions.name: parse_dsp_price
functions.input: str | None - DSP price HTML blob from the GeoJSON property
functions.if_none: None/empty/no-$ figure -> None (14+ rows legitimately carry no figure); $0 -> 0.0, never None

functions.name: derive_status
functions.input: stage str|None + special-comments str|None from source properties
functions.if_none: None stage -> UNKNOWN_STAGE; None special -> constrained False (narrow to the capacity phrase only)

functions.name: geom_to_multipolygon_wkt
functions.input: GeoJSON geometry dict, a Polygon feature from the source file
functions.output: MULTIPOLYGON WKT str -> ST_GeomFromText into geom(4326)
functions.if_none: empty/invalid-after-repair/non-polygon -> raises ValueError (fails the row loudly, never inserts junk geometry)

functions.name: clean
functions.if_none: None, empty string, or tags-only input all return None

values.if_missing: NULL stored; reader shows 'DSP charge: see Sydney Water land-development page' rather than a fabricated figure
NULL stored; DW file has no such key at all -> always NULL for DW (expected)

queries.purpose: Upsert the GSP polygons then delete rows absent from the source (snapshot replace)
queries.where_clause: ON CONFLICT (product, swc_id) DO UPDATE; then DELETE WHERE NOT EXISTS in source key set
queries.if_zero: N/A - insert path; after upsert+delete the count must equal the source row count or it rolls back
queries.if_wrong: Gate: final count must equal len(source rows), not a hard-coded number, so a refresh that adds/retires polygons stays consistent; mismatch rolls back the whole transaction

break_it.scenario: A source row's DSP price shows '$0' and a naive parser treats 0 as falsy, storing NULL - the reader then hides a genuinely $0 (already-serviced) charge.
break_it.what_happens: A user is told 'charge unavailable' when the real answer is $0 - understating serviceability readiness.
break_it.how: scripts/ingest_sydney_water_gsp.py:64 - parse_dsp_price returns float(0.0) for '$0', distinct from None. Covered by test_zero_is_valid_not_none and mutation 'price: $0 -> None' (KILLED).

break_it.scenario: The 'under investigation by DPHI' note (8 rows) is wrongly treated as a hard capacity constraint, flagging areas as constrained when they are only under study.
break_it.what_happens: A developer is told a site is capacity-constrained when it is not - a false negative that could kill a viable deal.
break_it.how: scripts/ingest_sydney_water_gsp.py:71 - constrained matches only 'capacity and timescale constraints'; the DPHI note is preserved in special_comments but does not set the flag. Covered by test_dphi_note_is_not_constrained and mutation 'status: DPHI note wrongly flagged' (KILLED).

break_it.scenario: A self-intersecting source polygon is repaired with buffer(0), which discards one lobe of a multi-part footprint, so ST_Contains lookups silently miss the dropped area.
break_it.what_happens: An address inside the discarded lobe returns NOT_IN_PRECINCT (wrong) instead of its real servicing status.
break_it.how: scripts/ingest_sydney_water_gsp.py:99 - geom_to_multipolygon_wkt uses make_valid (not buffer(0)) then keeps ALL polygonal parts via _polygonal_parts, so no lobe is lost; zero parts -> ValueError. Live check confirmed 0/397 invalid via ST_IsValid. Covered by test_invalid_bowtie_preserves_both_lobes.

break_it.scenario: A network drop mid-batch commits a partial upsert of the GSP polygons, or a GSP refresh retires a polygon and the stale row is left behind, so lookups return the wrong servicing status.
break_it.what_happens: A developer checking a covered growth-area site is wrongly told it is outside any servicing precinct, or served an obsolete status - a silent wrong answer indistinguishable from the honest gap.
break_it.how: scripts/ingest_sydney_water_gsp.py:229 - upsert + delete-absent (snapshot replace) run inside one transaction (autocommit off); the final count must equal len(source rows) or the whole transaction rolls back, so the table always mirrors the source snapshot and is all-or-nothing.
break_it.repro: Interrupt the --apply run mid-batch, then SELECT count(*) (unchanged, not partial); or inspect the delete-absent + count gate in apply().

post_merge.db_reset: No - additive new table, reversible by DROP TABLE sydney_water_gsp_servicing.
post_merge.secrets: No - DB creds read from existing .env PG* vars; no new secrets.
post_merge.manual_verify: No - migration 058 already applied to the live DB and verified (397 rows, live point-in-polygon returns Leppington WW+DW, outside point empty, 0 invalid geometries).
